eligibility.exact_action_basis: The whole as-amended House choice would permit the Treasury Secretary, after consultation with FEMA and upon a written request from a Governor or the DC Mayor, to apply the specified existing tax-postponement rules to a qualified state-declared disaster. Qualification retains the printed catastrophe/fire/flood/explosion and severity determination, and State includes the listed territories and DC. Separately, the bill replaces the specified mandatory-extension 60-day terms with 120 days; these are not an automatic extension for every state declaration or every tax deadline. The amendments apply to declarations after enactment. The bill does not supply all surrounding subsections of section7508A, certify current tax deadlines, establish a federal disaster declaration or direct construction, repairs or disaster grants.

The whole as-amended House choice would expressly allow appointment of counsel in the Office of the Taxpayer Advocate reporting directly to the National Taxpayer Advocate or a delegate. Its conforming replacement extends the identified employee reference from employees of a local taxpayer-advocate office to any employee of the Office of the Taxpayer Advocate. The printed effective-date clause would treat the amendments as included in section1102 of the1998 IRS restructuring law; this is not a present appointment, an independently verified historical right or a complete reconstruction of that incorporated provision. No taxpayer outcome, agency budget, technology deployment or actual legal advice follows from this vote.

The whole as-amended House choice directs USPS, within270days after enactment, to designate a single unique ZIP Code for each of the66 separately enumerated entries, including the specifically named communities and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The complete printed list controls, including similar names in different states and the final Hochatown/Green/Rochester/Quartzite Township/Frederick/Camargo/Wheatfield/Mauldin/Josephine entries. This does not itself establish municipal boundaries, change postal routes or street addresses, build facilities or certify an actual/current ZIP assignment. No preference on a single listed place is separately inferred from the whole vote.

The whole as-amended House choice would make actions by the SEC Advocate for Small Business Capital Formation under the identified subsection not a collection of information for Paperwork Reduction Act purposes, while expressly retaining requirements in44USC3506(c)(1),(c)(4),(i) and3507(a)(1)(A). It then excepts the specified OMB submission, control-number display and associated notice, and clearance-compliance indication requirements. The retained review duties and limited exceptions are both operative parts of this choice; it is not removal of every review or every agency information-collection requirement, nor a newly established data platform, capital award, business outcome or current regulatory-status determination. The full surrounding incorporated duties remain unintegrated. Available dated3502definitions and3506(c)/(i)units provide context: the bill retains specified internal review/inventory/respondent-information, small-business-burden and liaison duties subject to its explicit carveouts. It does not incorporate all(c)(2)/(3)or unrelated general IT duties merely by adjacency. Complete78d(j),3507(a)(1)(A), other applicable crossreferences and current law remain unintegrated.

The whole House choice repeals section213 of titleII/divisionC of the named2026appropriations Act AND the amendments made by that section, declaring them without force or effect. The retained complete section213 supplies the target: covered-data/Senate-data/person-capacity definitions and device/account notice predicates, the Senate Ethics subpoena exclusion, provider/SAA written notice and notice/liability protections, target-investigation court delay of at most60days with conditional renewals versus no delay for other investigations, and the specified private civil remedy against the United States. The latter includes each discrete-instance definition, prevailing-claim greater-of500000dollars-or-actual-damages award plus reasonable fees/costs and appropriate relief, five-year actual-notice limitation, printed immunity/sovereign-immunity provisions, four conjunctive target-investigation defense requirements and constitutional/intervention savings. Section213 also contains the January1,2022 applicability and special pre-enactment-notice limitations rule. These identify the whole repeal target, not evidence of an actual unlawful collection, lawsuit, payment, Senator motive or present law. The full pre-section213 statute and independent consequences of repeal are not reconstructed; no general elimination of all Senate notice/privacy/constitutional protections is asserted. The available dated2024section6628(a)-(h)baseline distinguishes retained office possession from technical intermediary custody, permission to notify from an affirmative duty, and prompt-motion quash-OR-modify from automatic universal quashing. Intended-recipient use, applicable privileges, SAA information duties and qualified inconsistent-State-law preemption remain context, not proof of prior-law revival, immediate pre213version, accrued-claim cancellation or current legal effects.
